intent: Implement the November 26 intelligence audit, retain concurrent work, qualify the draft and main revisions, and verify release assets.

checkpoints.details: Integration head includes the five voice changes made after the audited revision. The second open PR is already an ancestor.
Retained both newer voice commits. Added bounded GitHub retrieval, ephemeral graphs, Jobs projections and pressure, Copilot parity, observed verdicts and independently labeled source QA.
Preserved incoming microphone routing and regenerated both Android inventory files from the combined tree.

The API 34 emulator on workflow 45913191695, job 140226354255, could not find Stop benchmark after the test clicked Start without first bringing it into view. The API 36 matrix job 140226354564 passed on the same source. The acceptance harness sets a 320 dp wide viewport and 2x font scale. The integrated head retains the same benchmark screen and test. Bring both controls into view, wait for the running state and retain the terminal state and readable export assertions.

Android lint job 140223904547 in workflow 45912349608 reported NonObservableLocale in the voice benchmark results. The same expression remained in the integrated source. Use the active Compose locale to format benchmark measurements as the language changes.

PR 2646 reached main with the Android 0.9.66.18 build 152 and Gateway 18.1.5 publication request. With the same versions, both release trigger decisions were false for PR 2651. Reserve Android 0.9.66.19 build 153 and Gateway 18.1.6 for this PR so the signed assets can identify its own qualified merge.

The Android unit suite reported two failures in 15,118 tests. The integrated phone enum added ISSUE_INTAKE while the service contract and count assertion still described the earlier wire format. A truncated tree read with no directory identity threw a generic exception before the incomplete-tree result could be returned. Both paths remain present at the source revision.

The API 34 emulator rendered the Stop benchmark button, but the unpacked benchmark finished before Compose injected the tap. The stack identified VoiceEntryInstrumentedTest.kt:59 and the last rendered stop semantics. The same test remains on the integrated head. Hold initial model discovery in the isolated test directory until the real Stop button accepts cancellation, then verify the cancelled run identity and complete stage inventory in its exported JSON.

The release scope check rejected five exact paths from the concurrent Gateway reasoning and continuation repair. Reviewed the checklist and budget implementation, the two named regression files and their diagnostic record. Include these paths and describe the user-visible change in the coordinated release.

verification.qaConditions: One first attempt per arm per question, fixed Gateway/desktop/Android component corpus, identical immutable source and 12000-byte budget. No product model invoked. Candidate implementation indexed C# and XAML.
